Why Call Kudu

Built for the busy hours.

Not another voicemail. A front desk that answers, books, and hands over when a human is needed.

Always there when you’re busy

Phone and WhatsApp answered professionally — day, night, and weekends — so customers don’t bounce to a competitor.

Book without the back-and-forth

Connect your calendar or send a booking link. Callers and chatters can lock in a time while you stay focused on the floor.

Stay in the loop

Follow-ups, messages, and callbacks land in one place. Escalate complex calls to your mobile the moment a person is needed.

Sounds like your front desk

Train it on your business, pick a South African voice and tone, and greet callers the way you would — not like a call centre script.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know before you go live.

A smart virtual receptionist holds a two-way conversation in real time. Unlike voicemail, Call Kudu can book appointments, answer questions, and send text messages immediately — keeping your business live 24/7.

Any business that answers the phone or WhatsApp. If customers reach you for questions, bookings, or to leave a message, Call Kudu can cover those conversations when you’re busy — and hand over to you when a person is needed.

You choose a natural South African voice and tone, then preview the greeting with your business name before you go live. Most callers experience a clear, professional front desk — not a tinny robocall.

No technical skills required. Preview with your business name in under a minute, then follow a short guided setup for your number, voice, and call forwarding or WhatsApp. When you’re ready, turn the receptionist on.

No. You keep your existing number and simply set up call forwarding when you’re busy or after a few rings. You stay in full control of your primary business line.

Yes. Link your WhatsApp Business number in Channels. You can turn WhatsApp answering on or off whenever you need.

It takes a detailed message, flags the conversation for your attention, or transfers to you if the caller asks for a person. Customers always feel heard.

When recording is enabled for your account, callers hear a spoken notice at the start of the call. You’re responsible for lawful use in your jurisdiction; see our Privacy Policy and Terms for details.
